hero.lines: Bokkoms Self-Catering Guesthouse invites you to Paternoster Village that offers something for food, art and nature lovers alike.
hero.body: A two-bedroom self-catering guest flat in Paternoster with the convenience of on-suite bathrooms equipped kitchen private patio exits and part views on Bekbay beach. We are few minutes on foot to Bekbaai Beach, hosts available on the premises to assist to improve your stay with us.

intro.title: Enter your home away from home via a flight of stairs into a cosy holiday nesting space.
intro.lede: Our guests enjoy a private lounge, kitchen and two en-suite bedrooms, One Queen size bed and 2 Single beds each with its own working space. Bedrooms are spacious with space for all your personal luggage. Fast free wi-fi available.  Each bedroom exits onto a private patio and outdoor cooking area. Lounge on a  hammock while you enjoy a  part view on the Bekbay beach.
intro.body: Your hosts live and work upstairs, so we are close by for advice or a hand whenever you need it, and out of the way when you don’t. Bring the dog, too: pets are welcome by prior arrangement.

quote.text: Stunning place, stunning location. Beautiful short walk to the beach in a very quiet area. Only the birds and waves to be heard!
